title: Vessel Finance (Scroll) — zk-DEX VaultProxy; all value-moving paths role-gated (no permissionless payout)
closed_reasons: withdraw() pays only against pendingWithdraw credits; credits are written solely inside commitSnarkProof() which is onlyOperator
commitSnarkProof reverts for any non-operator ('Gov: caller is not an operator')
fastWithdraw() is onlyExitManager and pays from the LP's own allowance to a recipient-address-bound EIP-712 signature; no redirection possible
fastWithdraw/withdraw/commitSnarkProof/admin entry points all revert for an unprivileged attacker (fork-tested)

all roles (admin/operator/exitManager) are grantable only by the admin; admin = AccessControl executor 0x3c417EC0 whose DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the 2-of-3 Gnosis Safe 0x9549F1d6; executor.execute() reverts for attackers
